verdict.rationale: Hugging Face runs inference through Inference Providers and Inference Endpoints, so prompt/prefix caching is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence pack never mentions caching of repeated context. The nearest items are adjacent: cheapest-provider routing, fastest-provider selection and lower reasoning effort, none of which is prefix caching.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can benefit from prompt/prefix caching that reduces latency or cost on repeated context
